preconditions.description: The number of integers N must be between 3 and 1000.
The number of queries Q must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= B[i][j] <= 5000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: All elements in the matrix B must be between 0 and 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N for _ in range(Q))
preconditions.description: Each row and column index p in the queries must be between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= F[i] <= 5000 for _ in range(Q) for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: All new values F in the queries must be between 0 and 5000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the sequence A as a space-separated string.
The output must contain Q + 1 lines, each with N integers.
The first element of the sequence A must always be 0.
